comment.uw_adj: dissolved funds removed from the policy accounting for half the AUM

rationale.general_comments:
2024 - Strong competition in HK market targetting reductions of 30% on this account. Have reduced rate by just under 30% and quoted a $10m primary in order to retain the account. We have removed some of the dissolved funds removing the run-off exposure for these funds going forward.
2023 - Intensed competition in HK. Managed to hold on to 26% discount. Manage limit at USD5m aggregate. Provided broader cover this year.
2022 - Incorporated in Cayman Island, focus on Properties in US.
rationale.other_factors_comments: 2022 - Aon HK move this account placement from USA to HK.
rationale.reason_comments: Fits within appetite and kept limit at USD5m, single tower.
